# daily-research

> An autonomous research feedback engine that runs inside the operator's research repositories. Every morning at 05:00, macOS launchd runs Claude Code (`claude -p`) for each line of a rotation window — `[general] lines_per_day` consecutive lines, three by default — each with the line's repo as the working directory. Seven repo lines map 1:1 to research repos: `akc` (agent-knowledge-cycle), `contemplative` (contemplative-agent), `aap` (agent-attribution-practice), `authorship` (authorship-strategy), `ans` (attention-not-self), `desire` (desire-frontier), `edge` (edge-frontier). One ecosystem line — `jev`, `mode = "ecosystem"`, `daily = true` — has no repo at all: it runs every morning outside the rotation with its own `state/<line>/` directory as the working directory and `--safe-mode`, and observes an external ecosystem's own changes (ADR-0018). Per line, call 1 (Opus, 25-min cap) reads a short line context, picks one external development relevant to the repo — for an ecosystem line, one meaningful change in the ecosystem since the last report — as a question, and ends in one of four content states — article, brief, quiet (nothing new), or hold — recorded in a run receipt; articles and briefs are written to an Obsidian vault. Call 2 (Sonnet, fresh context, 20-min cap, fail-open), run only when call 1 wrote a note, revises the note for first-contact readability and then re-fetches every claim in the run's evidence file to check it against the source. Notes carry no proposals or approval requests; the body has no fixed headings, and the only fixed sections are a deadline-only 機会メモ tail and ソース. Bash orchestration with prompt files; JSON/TOML parsing in stdlib python3 (no pip dependencies, no orchestration framework).

Status: active, maintained by hand in this repository and run every morning by the author.

## Architecture

- [ADR-0018](docs/adr/0018-ecosystem-mode-and-daily-jev-line.md): `mode = "ecosystem"` lines — no target repo, cwd = `state/<line>/`, `--safe-mode`, their own call-1 protocol; adds a repo-less execution form to ADR-0008 and configures a daily line again under ADR-0011 / ADR-0017 (the daily `jev` line)
- [ADR-0017](docs/adr/0017-three-line-window-content-states-and-verification-pass.md): rotation window of `lines_per_day` lines, four content states with a receipt-driven gate, per-line brief / pending / evidence state, question-level dedup, and call 2 as verification + clarity — the current execution shape; supersedes ADR-0016's retirement of the repo-centred design and ends ADR-0013's daily `edge` line
- [ADR-0014](docs/adr/0014-trend-explanation-report.md): report = one external development explained + implications for the repo; adversarial framing (corroboration ban, mandatory refutation, premise-challenge pass, scoring_criteria) retired — the current objective function
- [ADR-0010](docs/adr/0010-rotation-and-two-tier-eval.md): rotation + two-tier in-loop eval (question screen in call 1, fresh-context revision in call 2)
- [ADR-0011](docs/adr/0011-daily-line.md): `daily = true` lines run every day outside the rotation (the mechanism stays in the schema); partial-failure semantics (OK / E_PARTIAL / E_NO_REPORT = no line passed the gate)
- [ADR-0009](docs/adr/0009-explanatory-report-and-brief-retirement.md): explanatory reports instead of actionable-tactics notes; the 07:00 Slack approval brief retired
- [ADR-0008](docs/adr/0008-per-repo-in-context-research.md): per-repo in-context research (cwd = the repo); retires the concept-graph-driven theme selection
- [ADR-0006](docs/adr/0006-self-improvement-loop-human-consumer.md): self-improvement loop (report gate ctl-015, deterministic lint ctl-016, metrics.jsonl, /dr-review) — no LLM judge
- [ADR-0001](docs/adr/0001-research-repo-feedback-engine.md): why lines map to research repositories (historical origin); full index in [docs/adr/README.md](docs/adr/README.md) (0001–0018)
- [Per-repo research protocol](prompts/repo-research-protocol.md): call 1 for `mode = "repo"` lines — objective function, short-context start, diff-first pass, question selection and the four content states, citation gate, evidence file, run receipt
- [Ecosystem research protocol](prompts/ecosystem-research-protocol.md): call 1 for `mode = "ecosystem"` lines — same shared contract (receipt, evidence file, four content states, fixed tail sections), but two exploration paths every run (watchlist diff + broad search for unknown candidates), dedup by what changed since the last report, and a watchlist kept in `state/<line>/watched-sources.md`
- [Verification protocol](prompts/verification-protocol.md): call 2 — clarity first (defect detection only, no new facts), then every claim re-fetched and corrected against its source; writes verify.json
- [Report template](templates/report-template.md): three writing rules + `kind: article|brief` frontmatter + free-form body with no fixed headings + the two fixed tail sections (機会メモ / ソース)
- [Ecosystem report template](templates/report-template-ecosystem.md): the same frontmatter and two fixed tail sections for ecosystem lines, without the repo wording
- [Main entry point](scripts/daily-research.sh): rotation-pick window, per-line call 1 + call 2, retry, receipt-driven report gate, lint, metrics; `--allowedTools` path-scoped writes plus a `--disallowedTools Bash,Task,NotebookEdit` deny layer
- [Parsing module](scripts/lib/dr_pipeline.py): stdlib-only JSON/TOML — rotation-pick, line-brief, past-themes, receipt-read, verify-read, config-get, report-lint, metrics-append, expect-check

## Data

- [metrics.example.jsonl](metrics.example.jsonl): shape of one `metrics.jsonl` record (pass1 null, pass2 = summed call-1 runs, clarity_pass, lint, line_states, verification)
